message: ５分４分３分２分１分ジャスト
15 minutes before doors open.

name: Misa
message: 「You're late!」

name: Synn
message: 「Thanks」

name: Misa
message: 「All the rehearsals are finished. I made up a pretext about a final inspection and had everyone unrelated to the Student Council leave」

name: Synn
message: 「Sorry about that. Where's Azel!?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「According to Melilot-san's calculations, it'll be in five minutes. Here, put this on」
It was an earphone-type transceiver.
According to our prior briefing, once Azel's appearance is detected, we are supposed to launch a coordinated attack on Riesling-san's signal.
As I fit the transceiver into my ear, I silently apologize in my heart: I'm sorry, Riesling-san.

name: Riesling
message: 「Four minutes remaining until the predicted time.」

name: Misa
message: 「Will she really show up, I wonder?」

name: Ria
message: 「A girl in love never breaks a promise made to the boy she loves」

name: Ria
message: 「Probably」

name: Misa
message: 「It is just as you say, Onee-sama. That is how the world ought to be」

name: Misa
message: 「Just like a wonderful novel」

name: Lolotte
message: 「B-But in the Human World... awawa, generally speaking, not showing up at a time like that is what makes it a tragic romance」

name: Ria
message: 「T-Tragic romance...」

name: Misa
message: 「That pattern is wonderful too...\s04」

name: Misa
message: 「I mean, no it isn't! I-It's not like I'm hoping things don't work out between them or anything!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Before that, what's the point of hiding that you're an angel at this point!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Gasp!? That's right!」

name: Riesling
message: 「Three minutes remaining until the predicted time. All personnel, stand by at your designated positions.」

name: Everyone
message: 「Roger!」
It seems neither Riesling-san nor Helena-san has caught on to our true intentions.

name: Misa
message: 「I'll back you up if anything happens, so make sure you do this properly」

name: Lolotte
message: 「President-san. Let's go save the world」

name: Ria
message: 「Synn-kun. You've got this」
Everyone scatters to their designated positions.

name: Nanaka
message: 「Did you see the exhibit?」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I'm the one who arranged it」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Well, the photos were good, so it probably would've turned out to be a great exhibit no matter how they were arranged, though」

name: Synn
message: 「Thanks」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Don't mention it, don't mention it」

name: Riesling
message: 「Two minutes remaining until the estimated time.」
Nanaka, who had started to walk away, stopped in her tracks for some reason.

name: Nanaka
message: 「Hey, Synn」

name: Synn
message: 「What?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「What will you do if Azel doesn't show up like this?」

name: Synn
message: 「She'll show up」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I see. Then, before that happens, wanna kiss?」

name: Synn
message: 「What do you mean, 'then'?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Just kidding. Joke, joke. Pull yourself together and do it right, you lady-killer!」
Nanaka gave my back a forceful slap and walked off.

name: Paqy
message: 「You brought that on yourself. Well, it goes both ways for you and Soba, though」

name: Paqy
message: 「Good thing Soba has the kind of personality she does」

name: Riesling
message: 「One minute remaining until the estimated time.」
Maybe that's true.
Nanaka had liked me all this time, and I hadn't noticed it at all.
I was dense and completely clueless.
Sure, Nanaka never told me, but at the very least, I have no right to blame her for that.
Still, I love Azel. And that isn't going to waver anymore.
That's why, even if I knew how Nanaka felt, there's nothing I could do about it.
Even now, I'm thinking about Azel instead of Nanaka.
I'm thinking about how I should talk to her when we see each other again after so long.

name: Riesling
message: 「Spatial distortion confirmed. 10, 9, 8, 7, 6, 5, 4, 3」
What should I say to her, and how should I say it?

name: Riesling
message: 「2, 1, zero」
The empty space in the center of the plaza shimmered like a heat haze.
